items.reason: The added add_members action loops over every supplied username and calls User.find_by_username separately (app/controllers/admin/groups_controller.rb:71-74); that method executes find_by(username_lower: ...) (app/models/user.rb:175-176). Consequently, large bulk additions incur one database lookup per username, creating avoidable database round trips and latency. Batching should preserve the existing case-insensitive lookup semantics.
